display_long_description:
Even you can become a great artist! 

ARTIST SIMULATOR
"Impaso: The Lost Artist" is an artist simulator experience with a light story and progression. You play as a clockwerk artist who begins in a back alley, selling art on the streets and progressing toward building your own grand Gallery!

PAINT AND SELL ART
You can just paint anything, selling your art, take commissions, and progress at your own pace through the 4-act Story 

STORY AND ENDING
Your performance during the main Story will leads to either a good or bad ending.

UNLOCK TOOLS AND GALLERIES
- Realistic Painting Simulation
- 4 painting modes: E-Ink, Acrylic, Oil and Watercolor
- 12 quirky NPCs with different taste, those who will roast your art
- 4-act story to progress, with a light-narrative and commissions/tasks
- Sell your art, earn money to unlock new brushes, new galleries, living spaces as you advance
